probability_notes: Explicit categorical probabilities per dimension; visible marks use Bernoulli presence probabilities and must not sum to one.
Human options are illustrative, not population/genetic claims. Do not infer behavior, ability or personality from physical appearance.
Anatomy-specific Wookiee and Twilek dimensions demonstrate extensions beyond the contemporary example region.
Infants/children need a smaller applicable dimension set and age-conditioned body metrics; adult facial-hair, hair-loss and mark priors are not used for them.
Hairstyle requires joint compatibility with length, texture and coverage. Base PMFs are not a ready independent sampler.
